notes.title: Patch 2.0 Live
notes.content:
Patch 2.0 is now live and with it the second DLC: The Graveyard.

All players, regardless whether they purchase the new DLC, will gain access to the following features:

Companions: These non-combat pets are great side kicks and even collect drops for you. They can be obtained through special quests or by defeating bosses. 
Shineys: This new type of collectable can be found in most areas and serves as a currency for special items. At the moment, they can be used to purchase certain companions.
Automatic salvaging: Select item rarities to be automatically salvaged for materials when picked up. 
An increased level of difficulty for dungeons, which rewards items of level 3.


Buying the second DLC gives access to the tower's second floor, which serves as Scak's graveyard. 
It contains the following areas:
2 Hack'n'Slay Dungeons with 5 bosses
1 Hack'n'Slay group dungeon for 4 players with 2 bosses and additional hardmodes
1 Jump'n'Run style dungeon
1 Beat'em'up style dungeon with 2 bosses
1 special tower level endboss with additional hardmodes
To enter the new areas, you need to defeat the Brood Mother in the first floor of the tower.


Patch 2.0 also contains several bugfixes and improvements to UI and controls.


Cheers,
Inner World Games

notes.title: Patch 1.3 Live
notes.content:
Dear players,

Patch 1.3 is now live and brings full support for Mouse + Keyboard in all ingame menus, as well as more minor improvements. 

We also fixed an issue that could reset parts of your progress when playing a cooperative game with someone who is less advanced in the story.

notes.title: Patch 1.2 Live
notes.content:
Dear players,

we heard your feedback and see the problems that many of you have with the controls and the overall accessibility of the game. 

While we intended the game to be played with a gamepad, we could have done a better job with the mouse + keyboard support. Therefore, patch 1.2 adds mouse support in the character creation and selection screens. Furthermore, we are working on mouse support for the in-game menu which will be included in one of the next patches.

Another problem proved to be the missing explanations for the buttons and their purpose, which we addressed by improving the information given in the game and adding descriptions to the UI buttons. We will continue to work on the UI to make it more clear and intuitive.

Thanks for your interest in the game!
